capabilities.status_reason: ios-accessibility adds synchronous setters for accessibility element status, label, hint, and value, a synchronous `isAccessibilityElement` property read, nullable label/hint/value presence checks, and seventeen UIKit traits on a borrowed, caller-owned UIView. The adapter requires the UIKit main thread and is !Send/!Sync; trait updates replace the full mask and may override UIKit defaults. Adjustable requires accessibilityIncrement and accessibilityDecrement; NotEnabled requires a view that does not respond to input; KeyboardKey requires key behavior; UpdatesFrequently and PlaysSound rely on host-owned value updates and activation sound; CausesPageTurn requires host page-turn behavior via accessibilityScroll:; StartsMediaSession applies only when activation starts a media session; AllowsDirectInteraction applies only to caller-marked content that supports direct touch; SummaryElement requires caller-supplied summary content. The adapter routes no input, configures no DirectTouchOptions, adds no callback or audio behavior, makes no presentation-timing promise, reports only the accessibility-element property (not visibility or focus); its nullable text-property checks return no text, empty strings count as present, and UIKit defaults do not prove caller assignment; it makes no live VoiceOver claim. B120 checks membership for a requested known trait without exposing the raw mask or unknown flags. B123 gets and sets the child-elements-hidden property through an iOS 5.0+ selector guard; absent selectors return `AccessibilityApiUnavailable` without raising the package's iOS 4.0 floor. It does not set the receiver's own element flag, visual hidden state, or interaction state. B126 reads/writes `shouldGroupAccessibilityChildren` under an iOS 6.0 selector guard for logical parent groups; B129 reads/writes `accessibilityViewIsModal` under an iOS 5.0 selector guard for actually modal accessible content. Neither claims assistive traversal, view presentation, or app modality. B132 adds selector-guarded `set_accessibility_language(Option<&str>)` and `has_accessibility_language()` for UIKit BCP 47 `accessibilityLanguage`; `None` clears, other input passes unchanged without validation/normalization, and the getter does not report effective assistive-app language or invoke the iOS 17 callback. B135 adds selector-guarded `accessibility_responds_to_user_interaction()` and `set_accessibility_responds_to_user_interaction(bool)` for the iOS 13.0 `accessibilityRespondsToUserInteraction` property; its default can derive from other accessibility properties, and the setter creates no interaction handler. B138 adds selector-guarded `AccessibilityNavigationStyle` getter/setter with `Automatic`, `Separate`, and `Combined`; unknown native values are returned as `None`, not raw integers. The iOS 8.0 property currently affects Switch Control only, not VoiceOver, and does not raise the package iOS 4.0 floor. B141 adds selector-guarded `set_accessibility_textual_context(Option<AccessibilityTextualContext>)` and `has_accessibility_textual_context()` for iOS 13.0 `accessibilityTextualContext`. The enum maps seven named UIKit `NSString` constants; `None` clears, and the methods neither invoke the iOS 17 callback nor claim assistive output. B144 adds selector-guarded `accessibility_container_type()` and `set_accessibility_container_type(AccessibilityContainerType)` at iOS 11.0 for `Unspecified`, `List`, and `Landmark`; unknown values map to `None`. `DataTable` needs `UIAccessibilityContainerDataTable`, and iOS 13 `SemanticGroup` is excluded without per-value availability handling. B147 declines `accessibilityDirectTouchOptions` because its VoiceOver passthrough/audio behavior needs a dedicated direct-touch contract. B150 adds iOS 13 `accessibilityUserInputLabels` set and non-empty-presence operations behind selector guards; it sends an explicit array even for empty input, may observe UIKit defaults, and claims no speech recognition match or iOS 17 callback behavior. B153 adds selector-guarded iOS 5 `accessibilityActivationPoint` getter/setter over `CGPoint` screen coordinates; UIKit defaults to the midpoint of `accessibilityFrame`, callers must recompute after layout or screen-position changes, and no assistive activation outcome is promised. B156 adds selector-guarded iOS 11 `accessibilityAttributedLabel` set and non-empty-presence operations over `NSAttributedString`; UIKit copies the value and couples it to `accessibilityLabel`, and the adapter invokes no iOS 17 callback or claims speech behavior. B159 adds selector-guarded iOS 11 `accessibilityAttributedHint` set and non-empty-presence operations over `NSAttributedString`; UIKit copies the value and couples it to `accessibilityHint`, and the adapter invokes no iOS 17 callback or claims speech behavior. B162 adds selector-guarded iOS 11 `accessibilityAttributedValue` set and non-empty-presence operations over `NSAttributedString`; UIKit copies the value and couples it to `accessibilityValue`, and the adapter invokes no iOS 17 callback or claims speech behavior. B171 adds selector-guarded iOS 7 `accessibilityPath` set and non-empty-presence operations using `UIBezierPath` screen coordinates; callers own geometry updates, and no assistive highlighting or activation result is claimed. B174 adds selector-guarded `accessibilityFrame` getter/setter over screen-coordinate `CGRect`. UIKit does not declare an explicit minimum for this property; selector checks preserve the package floor, and no conversion, layout, visibility, assistive-output result, or `UIAccessibilityElement` container-space behavior for `UIView` is claimed. B177 adds selector-guarded iOS 5 `UIAccessibilityIdentification.accessibilityIdentifier` get/set; the getter returns owned text or `None`, and the setter clears with `None`. It is UI Automation metadata, not a label, uniqueness guarantee, or assistive-output contract. `accessibilityFrameInContainerSpace` is excluded because the binding exposes it on `UIAccessibilityElement`, not `UIView`. B180 adds `UIAccessibilityTraitTabBar` (iOS 10.0) for a view that represents an ordered tab list; the caller separately sets `isAccessibilityElement` to false. B183 declines `UIAccessibilityTraitToggleButton` (iOS 17.0) because the generated static has no per-trait availability result for supported iOS 12–16 deployment targets. B186 adds selector-guarded iOS 18 `AccessibilityExpandedStatus` get/set with `Unsupported`, `Expanded`, and `Collapsed` values; unknown native getter values return `None`. The methods do not call `accessibilityExpandedStatusBlock` or expand/collapse content, and the block can take precedence. B189 declines `accessibilityElements`: its untyped `NSArray` setter replaces and retains a child array, but the borrowed-view adapter has no safe mixed-element ownership, cleanup, or container-state contract. B210/B213/B216 add selector-guarded nullable plain label/hint/value getters with nil/empty preservation and Rust-owned text; B219/B222 return retained immutable attributed label/hint values. No dynamic callback or speech/output claim is made. B225 adds the selector-guarded accessibilityAttributedValue getter as a retained immutable attributed value; it preserves nil and invokes no callback or speech/output behavior.; B255 adds Guided Access-gated AssistiveTouch state: it returns None when Guided Access is off to avoid the documented false-value ambiguity, and calls require iOS 10+ plus main-thread proof. B258 adds a main-thread Guided Access snapshot at iOS 6+. B261 and B268 add main-thread Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency snapshots at iOS 8+. B271 and B273 add Speak Screen and Speak Selection setting snapshots through generated C functions at iOS 8+; caller availability guards are required because the bindings provide no runtime guard. None invokes speech, observes setting-change notifications, or claims assistive output; B276 adds classic_invert_is_enabled(&MainThread), a main-thread Classic Invert setting snapshot using UIAccessibilityIsInvertColorsEnabled() at iOS 6.0+. The caller must guard availability because the generated C binding has no runtime guard; it adds no observer or display behavior B279 adds the main-thread On/Off Labels setting snapshot; B281 adds Bold Text; B284 adds Mono Audio; B287 adds Shake to Undo; B290 adds Differentiate Without Color; B292 adds Closed Captions + SDH; and B295 adds `cross_fade_transitions_are_preferred(&MainThread)`. These are settings-only snapshots with caller availability requirements; they add no setting observer, animation, audio, undo, caption rendering, or assistive behavior. Apple defines the cross-fade result as true only when both Reduce Motion and Prefer Cross-Fade Transitions are enabled. B297 adds selector-guarded `accessibility_ignores_invert_colors()` get/set for the iOS 11+ UIView property; the setter exempts the view subtree from accessibility-requested color inversion only and does not infer resulting colors or settings. All UIKit property access remains on the main thread; see `PLAN_IOS_ACCESSIBILITY.md`. B299 adds selector-guarded `shows_large_content_viewer()` get/set for the iOS 13+ `UIView.showsLargeContentViewer` property, with caller availability checks because the generated wrapper has no runtime guard. Setting it does not attach `UILargeContentViewerInteraction` or present UI; the host owns that interaction, and the property alone does not guarantee the viewer appears. B305 adds `increase_contrast_is_enabled(&MainThread)` as a main-thread, iOS 8.0+ caller-guarded snapshot of UIKit’s Increase Contrast setting. It does not observe setting changes, mutate colors, or claim that UIKit applies contrast to app-owned drawing. B309 adds `color_filters_or_grayscale_preference_is_enabled(&MainThread)` as a main-thread, iOS 8.0+ caller-guarded snapshot of UIKit’s Color Filters/Grayscale preference state. It does not identify the active filter, report rendered colors, observe setting changes, or alter display output. B313 adds `video_autoplay_previews_are_enabled(&MainThread)` as a main-thread, iOS 13.0+ caller-guarded snapshot of UIKit’s Auto-Play Video Previews setting. It reports no app-video autoplay behavior, observes no setting changes, and performs no playback or UI action. B317 adds `hearing_device_paired_ear(&MainThread) -> HearingDevicePairingStatus` as a main-thread, iOS 10.0+ caller-guarded snapshot of UIKit’s Made for iPhone hearing-aid ear-side pairing status. The Rust-owned enum preserves unknown native bits; it exposes no device identity and makes no connection, streaming, or audio-route claim. B325 adds `AccessibilityMetadata::convert_frame_to_screen_coordinates(frame_in_view: CGRect) -> CGRect` as a main-thread, iOS 7.0+ caller-guarded conversion from the borrowed view’s coordinate space to screen coordinates for `accessibilityFrame`. It does not mutate the view or claim visibility or presentation. B330 adds `AccessibilityMetadata::convert_path_to_screen_coordinates(path_in_view: &UIBezierPath) -> Retained<UIBezierPath>` as a main-thread, iOS 7.0+ caller-guarded view-to-screen path conversion. It returns a new owned path and leaves the input and view unchanged; it makes no rendering, visibility, or presentation claim. B379 adds `AccessibilityContainerType::SemanticGroup` at iOS 13.0+ with a caller availability guard; unknown native values remain `None`, and no child creation or assistive-output result is claimed. B382 adds typed `AccessibilityImageSizing` get/set for borrowed `UIImageView` and `UIButton` receivers on the main thread with a caller iOS 11.0+ guard; scalable content and layout remain host-owned. B410 adds a main-thread Guided Access restriction-state query for one app-registered identifier with a caller iOS 7.0+ guard; `Allow` does not establish registration or an active session, and the API does not enforce `Deny`. B434 adds a main-thread `button_shapes_are_enabled(&MainThread)` snapshot of UIKit’s Button Shapes preference with a caller iOS 14.0+ guard; UIKit deprecated the query from iOS 26.1 in favor of `AXShowBordersEnabled`, and the snapshot promises no rendered-button behavior.

capabilities.status_reason: ios-files implements sandbox file reads, writes, directory operations, removal, and existence checks with descriptor-relative no-follow traversal, plus synchronous adoption of URLSession temporary downloads by staged copy and atomic rename to AppPath. A concurrent native directory rename can move an opened directory outside the selected root, so containment is not guaranteed under that race. B128 adds `IosFiles::directory_entry_count`, which counts direct names except `.` and `..` across all entry kinds and byte names without building a Rust-owned listing or doing per-entry kind lookups. It is O(n), libc may allocate, and concurrent changes can affect the result; it is not an atomic snapshot, reservation, or deletion guard. B131 adds `IosFiles::directory_is_empty`, which stops at the first direct name other than `.` and `..` when nonempty. Both directory queries are best-effort under concurrent mutation; emptiness is not a delete guard. B134 adds `IosFiles::directory_entry_kind_counts` for regular-file, directory, and `Other` totals using no-follow per-name classification. It includes non-UTF-8 names and returns an error rather than partial counts if an enumerated name vanishes; it is not an atomic snapshot or delete guard. B137 adds `IosFiles::volume_available_capacity_bytes(AppDirectory)` from checked `f_bavail * f_bsize` on the retained root descriptor. This is a volume-wide point-in-time value, not an app quota, reservation, or write guarantee. Apple classifies `fstatfs` under required-reason `NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace`; the host must declare an approved reason matching actual use in `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`, and the library adds no manifest. B140 declines `NSURLDirectoryEntryCountKey` as a cheap-count API: it is optional and filesystem-dependent, while descriptor `ATTR_DIR_ENTRYCOUNT` is 32-bit, may be expensive, and is not supported by every volume format. B128/B131 remain the deterministic direct-count and early-stop paths. B143 declines `f_bfree` as a separate app-facing value because it includes reserved filesystem blocks that the sandbox cannot consume; B137 already reports `f_bavail` for non-superusers. B146 adds `IosFiles::volume_total_capacity_bytes(AppDirectory)` from checked `f_blocks * f_bsize` on the retained root descriptor. It describes the mounted volume, not physical-device capacity or an app quota, and shares B137's required-reason Disk Space privacy-manifest obligation. B149 declines `f_files`/`f_ffree` as app-specific capacity: these are volume-wide node counts, not an app/container budget, and `f_ffree` does not establish whether a later sandbox create will succeed. Actual creation remains authoritative. User-selected/provider URLs are unsupported. B235 adds `IosFiles::directory_allocated_size_snapshot(AppPath)` from descriptor-bound `fgetattrlist(ATTR_DIR_ALLOCSIZE)`, reporting bytes used by the directory object only, not descendants, quota, reservation, or performance. Host use requires an applicable approved File Timestamp reason in `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`. B237 declines `ATTR_DIR_DATALENGTH` because it measures the directory object, not child contents, and adds no supported operation. B238 declines `ATTR_DIR_IOBLOCKSIZE` because the facade has no directory-data I/O or buffer control. B240 declines `ATTR_DIR_LINKCOUNT` because it is not a child-directory count and B134 already counts direct subdirectories. B241 declines `ATTR_DIR_MOUNTSTATUS` because no mount or recursive traversal operation consumes it. B242 adds `IosFiles::regular_file_total_fork_size_snapshot(AppPath)` from descriptor-bound `fgetattrlist(ATTR_FILE_TOTALSIZE)`. It reports logical bytes across all forks for one regular file; it does not expose fork contents, only the data-fork read size, or physical allocation. Host use requires an applicable approved File Timestamp reason in `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`. B244 adds `IosFiles::regular_file_data_fork_allocated_size_snapshot(AppPath)` from descriptor-bound `fgetattrlist(ATTR_FILE_DATAALLOCSIZE)`, reporting bytes allocated for the data fork only and excluding resource-fork allocation. It does not convert B109 `st_blocks`, claim exact physical device use, or expose fork contents. Host use requires an applicable approved File Timestamp reason in `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`. B247 declines `ATTR_FILE_FORKCOUNT`: it reports only a fork count, not fork names, sizes, or access, and no facade operation consumes it. B248 adds `IosFiles::regular_file_resource_fork_allocated_size_snapshot(AppPath)` from descriptor-bound `fgetattrlist(ATTR_FILE_RSRCALLOCSIZE)`, reporting bytes allocated for the resource fork only. It reads no fork contents, and zero does not establish fork absence. Host use requires an applicable approved File Timestamp reason in `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`. B247 declines `ATTR_FILE_FORKCOUNT` because no fork-enumeration or fork-operation contract consumes the value. B251 adds `IosFiles::regular_file_resource_fork_size_snapshot(AppPath)` from descriptor-bound `fgetattrlist(ATTR_FILE_RSRCLENGTH)`, reporting logical bytes in the resource fork only. Zero does not prove absence; it exposes no fork enumeration, access, or contents. Host use requires an applicable approved File Timestamp reason in `PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy`. B253 declines `ATTR_FILE_ALLOCSIZE`: it adds another all-fork allocation scalar while B109 already exposes per-entry `st_blocks` and B244/B248 expose data/resource-fork allocation; no app-data operation needs the duplicate value, and no fixed conversion is assumed. B256 declines `ATTR_FILE_IOBLOCKSIZE` because no exposed stream, buffer, or policy consumes the optimal directory/file I/O hint; it is not an alignment or performance guarantee. B257 declines `ATTR_FILE_FORKLIST` because Apple documents an undefined attrreference payload, so no stable typed fork-list parser is possible. B259 declines obsolete HFS-specific `ATTR_FILE_DATAEXTENTS`/`ATTR_FILE_RSRCEXTENTS` because they expose at most eight possibly inaccurate extents and Apple directs new clients not to use them.
